# Sportradar
> Sportradar is a global sports technology company providing sports data, betting technology, media products, streaming, and integrity services.

Sportradar serves sports leagues, media companies, bookmakers, and digital platforms with real-time data, analytics, audiovisual products, and integrity solutions. Its site includes product information, company resources, investor materials, newsroom content, and developer-focused API documentation.

## Company
- [Homepage](https://sportradar.com/): Main overview of Sportradar’s sports technology, betting, media, and integrity offerings.
- [About Sportradar](https://sportradar.com/about/): Company background, mission, scale, and role across the sports ecosystem.
- [Leadership](https://sportradar.com/about/leadership/): Executive leadership team and company management information.
- [Careers](https://sportradar.com/careers/): Open roles, hiring information, and working at Sportradar.
- [Contact](https://sportradar.com/contact/): Contact options for business, media, and general inquiries.

## Solutions
- [Products & Solutions](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/): Overview of Sportradar’s product portfolio across betting, media, and sports organizations.
- [Betting & Gaming](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/): Betting technology, managed trading, data, and sportsbook services for operators.
- [Media](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/): Fan engagement, content, widgets, and media-focused sports data products.
- [Sports Organizations](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/sports-organizations/): Solutions for leagues, federations, and teams including integrity and audience products.
- [Integrity Services](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/integrity-services/): Match-fixing detection, monitoring, investigations, and integrity education services.
- [Audiovisual](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/audiovisual/): Streaming and audiovisual sports content solutions for betting and media clients.

## Developer & APIs
- [Developer Portal](https://developer.sportradar.com/): Central hub for Sportradar APIs, documentation, onboarding, and developer resources.
- [Getting Started](https://developer.sportradar.com/getting-started/docs/intro): Introductory documentation for accessing and using Sportradar APIs.
- [API Reference](https://developer.sportradar.com/docs/read/home): Documentation index for available sports data and platform APIs.
- [Coverage Matrix](https://developer.sportradar.com/docs/read/coverage_information/coverage_matrix): Sport-by-sport coverage details for leagues, competitions, and data availability.
- [Change Log](https://developer.sportradar.com/docs/read/change_log): Product and API documentation updates across Sportradar developer offerings.
- [Support](https://developer.sportradar.com/support/home): Developer support resources and help channels.

## Sports APIs
- [Soccer APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/soccer/reference/overview): Soccer data APIs covering fixtures, results, statistics, and competition information.
- [Basketball APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/basketball/reference/overview): Basketball API documentation for leagues, schedules, play-by-play, and stats.
- [American Football APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/football/reference/overview): American football APIs for game data, rosters, drives, and player statistics.
- [Baseball APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/baseball/reference/overview): Baseball data APIs including schedules, boxscores, and player performance data.
- [Ice Hockey APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/ice-hockey/reference/overview): Ice hockey APIs for game events, standings, and team statistics.
- [Tennis APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/tennis/reference/overview): Tennis APIs for tournaments, matches, rankings, and player data.
- [Cricket APIs](https://developer.sportradar.com/cricket/reference/overview): Cricket APIs for fixtures, scorecards, standings, and competition coverage.

## Betting Technology
- [Managed Trading Services](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/managed-trading-services/): Outsourced trading services combining odds management, risk, and operational expertise.
- [Odds Services](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/odds-services/): Pre-match and live odds products for sportsbook operators.
- [Managed Sportsbook Services](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/managed-sportsbook-services/): End-to-end sportsbook operations and technology support for betting brands.
- [Bet Builder](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/bet-builder/): Same-game and custom bet construction tools for sportsbook engagement.
- [Live Channel Trading](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/live-channel-trading/): Live betting trading support and operational services for in-play markets.
- [iGaming](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/betting-and-gaming/igaming/): Casino and iGaming solutions complementing sportsbook operator offerings.

## Media & Fan Engagement
- [Fan Engagement](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/fan-engagement/): Interactive products and content tools designed to deepen audience engagement.
- [Marketing Services](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/marketing-services/): Audience activation and marketing solutions built on sports data and insights.
- [OTT](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/ott/): Streaming and over-the-top platform solutions for sports content distribution.
- [Ad:s](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/ads/): Sports advertising products and monetization tools for media and betting brands.
- [Widgets](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/widgets/): Embeddable sports widgets for scores, stats, schedules, and fan experiences.
- [Content Solutions](https://sportradar.com/products-and-solutions/media/content-solutions/): Data-driven editorial and visual content products for publishers and broadcasters.
